verdict.comment: It's likely that this will be fought out between COME ON JOHN, Busby and Lednikov and it could be a good scrap.

comments.alvesta: 0-13 for A Balding, 0-5 for this yard; coming down weights but not finishing any closer
comments.busby: 10yo but consistent form this winter and should be bang there once again
comments.comeonjohn: Consistent sort; close again six days ago and should be in serious contention once more
comments.fentiger: Seen far more often on turf and has a bit to prove on Tapeta; off since November
comments.forglen: Out the back all four races; wind surgery since; AW debut; not bred for this far
comments.lednikov: Can make the running, as when winning over C&D last month; firmly in each-way calculations
comments.luckyquestion: 0-12 in Ireland and 0-7 in Britain; lack of impact in Britain puts him down the list
comments.spartantimes: 0-7; minor honours in classifieds on last three runs (9.4f, 1m4f and 1m2f); tongue-tie now
comments.thecooleen: Well beaten on AW in all four starts since switch to Flat, latest at 33-1 in 1m2f handicap
comments.wathcourt: 0-19; probably stayed 1m4f on latest start (second attempt) but others are more persuasive

races.raceComment: comeonjohn is confidently preferred with a score of 61.0%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over busby. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include improving, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Al Suil Eile is feared under a small penalty but BILLY McGARRY may be able to end his run of placed efforts.

comments.alsuileile: Narrow win here ten days ago can be upgraded a touch; high on the list despite a penalty
comments.billymcgarry: C&D winner; banging at the door this year and should run his race once again
comments.lockdownlass: Current wellbeing hard to assess but this is a drop in class and she needs a market check
comments.mrslicker: Conditions to suit and he ran well here 17 days ago; more needed to end losing run though
comments.mrstanley: 28-race maiden who has to prove his stamina for 1m
comments.popfavorite: Last 6 wins have come at Newcastle but on a dangerous mark & K O'Neill replaces apprentice
comments.ringofgold: On a losing run but he was a promising 3rd tried in a visor last month; chance with repeat
comments.riverwharfe: Not beaten far over 7f last week but others are more appealing for win purposes at 1m

races.raceComment: alsuileile is marginally preferred with a score of 59.3%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and more progressive over billymcgarry. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Silver Samurai is interesting back from a break but BLUE PRINCE ran well in a red-hot C&D handicap last month and is preferred.

comments.aquacell: C&D win in November was followed by a good effort in Listed company; still low mileage
comments.blueprince: Below par latest but a repeat of a fine C&D 3rd in February would give him leading claims
comments.dutchkingdom: Ended 2024 in fine form over 6f; career-high mark to deal with after four months off
comments.legalreform: 3-4 over C&D this year, including making all last week; up in grade but can't rule out
comments.ormolulu: Good record at 6f here but still to prove quite so effective at this trip
comments.persuasion: On a feasible mark but first time out perhaps not the time to catch him
comments.silversamurai: On a handy mark and his record after a break heightens interest; capable of a big run

races.raceComment: legalreform is marginally preferred with a score of 59.4%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over aquacell. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 6 wins from 16 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: A strong pace would suit LESSAY and he can follow up his recent Kempton success. Narmar and King Of Ithaca are feared most.

comments.cholaempire: Conditions to suit and showed a willing attitude here latest; 6lb rise looks tough though
comments.federalenvoy: 3-4 over C&D, the latest four weeks ago when gamely making all; contender up just 2lb
comments.howimpressive: C&D winner on a dangerous mark; quiet this winter but Oisin Murphy an eyecatching booking
comments.justcallmepete: Conditions no problem but not at his best behind Federal Envoy here last month
comments.kingoffury: Changed hands since winning a Kempton handicap in September; tongue-tie absent on return
comments.kingofithaca: Conditions to suit and won well here three weeks ago; should remain competitive
comments.lessay: Ready 7f win at Kempton 16 days ago; up 4lb but this should be run to suit; contender
comments.milbanke: On a winning mark but he makes his stable debut after 284 days off
comments.mumayaz: Two 6f wins this year; unlucky in running last time; feasible mark & capable of going well
comments.narmar: Notable late headway behind Federal Envoy here four weeks ago; down 2lb and can do better
comments.perennial: Low mileage but he has yet to make much of an impact in AW handicaps for this yard
comments.touchwood: Last year's best efforts came on turf; not sure he's the answer back from a break

races.raceComment: kingofithaca is confidently preferred with a score of 59.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over justcallmepete. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: Having made the breakthrough last time when stepped up to this trip at this track, LEON TROTSKY may well build on that with another win.

comments.balgowan: 0-20 overall but runner-up in two of his four starts this winter; probably not far away
comments.billybathgate: Never dangerous in a first-time hood three weeks ago after layoff, but showed ability
comments.fiftyshadesaresdev: Often on the premises; unraced beyond 1m4f on Flat; 0-31 record is a disincentive
comments.freewheelin: While he's still capable of the odd minor honour, others are preferred for the win
comments.kittensdream: No win since February 2023 and he seldom beats more than one rival these days
comments.leontrotsky: Off the mark over C&D latest, doing it tidily from mid-division on his first go at 2m
comments.oceanridge: Won at Wolverhampton last March (unraced beyond 1m4f on Flat); recent efforts unconvincing
comments.scylla: Close up when third at Wolverhampton (1m6f) nine days ago in first-time blinkers
comments.sopharsogood: Underperformed this winter; visor replaced cheekpieces last time; first-time blinkers now
comments.tobytops: Yet to make a serious impact after six starts, the last three in handicaps this winter

races.raceComment: leontrotsky is marginally preferred with a score of 48.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over oceanridge. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include positive comments, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: Robert Cowell's CLOUD KING (nap), impressive over C&D on his reappearance in 2024, appeals as the type to enjoy a productive 4yo season.

comments.cinqueverde: Return to 5f can help but she looks vulnerable to less-exposed rivals
comments.cloudking: Easy C&D win a year ago; in and out afterwards but appeals as the type to progress in 2025
comments.goodearth: On a winning mark but returns from 146 days off and this may not be the day to catch him
comments.jenesaisquoi: Chance on 2024 best but an easy lead is unlikely and she needs to leave her return behind
comments.momaer: Dangerous mark and last two runs have been more encouraging; each-way shout
comments.moulinbooj: C&D winner 12 months ago; running well in defeat of late but a career best is required
comments.populardream: Good record over C&D and unlucky in running here latest; this is stronger though
comments.readyfreddiego: On his last winning mark but low-key return this month and headgear again absent
comments.rockofengland: 0-9 for this yard but down in the weights and he's had a wind op since last seen
comments.sevensees: Two 5f wins in Ireland; promising stable debut (6f) ten weeks ago; relatively low mileage
comments.springissprung: Two turf wins last year; feasible mark if ready to go after six months off; yard run two
comments.tanrapido: Unexposed sprinter; Chelmsford 3rd last October was promising; market useful after a break

races.raceComment: populardream is marginally preferred with a score of 56.6%. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
